title: Technical Security Report
scope: 8 network asset(s), host audit of web-prod-01, traffic capture 'demo:sensor-eth0'
narrative: The assessment identified 57 open finding(s): 13 critical, 17 high, 16 medium and 11 low. The aggregated risk score is 100/100, which corresponds to a critical level of risk. Critical findings must be remediated immediately (P1, 24-72 hours). Network health score of the latest capture is 0/100 with 13 anomaly(ies).

findings.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 affected by CVE-2021-42013
findings.description: Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773: path traversal and remote code execution in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 and 2.4.50. A public exploit is available.
findings.evidence: 80/tcp banner 'Apache httpd 2.4.49 (Unix) OpenSSL/1.0.1f' matches affected range (versions 2.4.49, 2.4.50).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later.

findings.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 affected by CVE-2022-22720
findings.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.52 and earlier fails to close the inbound connection when errors are encountered discarding the request body, exposing the server to HTTP request smuggling.
findings.evidence: 80/tcp banner 'Apache httpd 2.4.49 (Unix) OpenSSL/1.0.1f' matches affected range (<= 2.4.52).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.53 or later.

findings.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 affected by CVE-2023-25690
findings.description: Some mod_proxy configurations on Apache HTTP Server 2.4.0 through 2.4.55 allow HTTP request smuggling.
findings.evidence: 80/tcp banner 'Apache httpd 2.4.49 (Unix) OpenSSL/1.0.1f' matches affected range (>= 2.4.0 and <= 2.4.55).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.56 or later.

findings.title: OpenSSH 8.9p1 affected by CVE-2023-38408
findings.description: The PKCS#11 feature in ssh-agent has an insufficiently trustworthy search path, leading to remote code execution if an agent is forwarded to an attacker-controlled system.
findings.evidence: 22/tcp banner 'OpenSSH 8.9p1 Ubuntu 3ubuntu0.6 Ubuntu Linux; protocol 2.0' matches affected range (< 9.3p2).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.3p2 or later. Distribution package detected: verify with the distro security tracker, the fix may be backported without a version change.

findings.title: vsftpd 2.3.4 affected by CVE-2011-2523
findings.description: vsftpd 2.3.4 downloaded between 2011-06-30 and 2011-07-03 contains a backdoor which opens a shell on port 6200/tcp. A public exploit is available.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade vsftpd to 2.3.5 or later.

findings.title: Samba 4.5.9 affected by CVE-2017-7494
findings.description: SambaCry: a malicious client can upload a shared library to a writable share and cause the server to load and execute it (remote code execution). A public exploit is available.
findings.evidence: 445/tcp banner 'Samba smbd 4.5.9 workgroup: CORP' matches affected range (>= 4.5.0 and < 4.5.10).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Samba to 4.6.4 or later.

findings.title: OpenSSH 7.4 affected by CVE-2023-38408
findings.description: The PKCS#11 feature in ssh-agent has an insufficiently trustworthy search path, leading to remote code execution if an agent is forwarded to an attacker-controlled system.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.3p2 or later.

findings.title: Exim 4.89 affected by CVE-2019-10149
findings.description: Improper validation of recipient addresses in deliver_message() in Exim 4.87 to 4.91 allows remote command execution ("Return of the WIZard"). A public exploit is available.
findings.evidence: 25/tcp banner 'Exim smtpd 4.89' matches affected range (>= 4.87 and <= 4.91).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Exim to 4.92 or later.

findings.title: Apache Tomcat 9.0.30 affected by CVE-2020-1938
findings.description: Ghostcat: the AJP connector trusts incoming connections by default, allowing file read/inclusion (and RCE when uploads are possible) in Apache Tomcat. A public exploit is available.
findings.evidence: 8080/tcp banner 'Apache Tomcat 9.0.30' matches affected range (>= 9.0.0.M1 and < 9.0.31).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Apache Tomcat to 9.0.31 or later.

findings.title: Communication with known malicious IP 203.0.113.50
findings.description: Communication with known malicious IP 203.0.113.50
findings.evidence: 41943 packets / 62914500 bytes exchanged with 203.0.113.50 (IOC 203.0.113.50, source cybershield-sample: Sample data exfiltration endpoint)
findings.recommendation: Isolate the host, block the indicator at the perimeter, and start incident response (collect volatile evidence before remediation).

findings.title: Docker Engine API exposed without TLS
findings.description: Docker Engine API exposed without TLS on 10.10.0.21:2375/tcp.
findings.recommendation: Never expose the Docker socket over TCP without mutual TLS; bind to a unix socket only.

findings.title: No duplicate UID 0 (root-equivalent) accounts
findings.description: No duplicate UID 0 (root-equivalent) accounts
findings.evidence: Accounts with UID 0 besides root: svc-backup
findings.recommendation: Only 'root' may have UID 0. Investigate and remove/renumber other UID 0 accounts immediately.

findings.title: No accounts with empty passwords
findings.description: No accounts with empty passwords
findings.recommendation: Lock or set a strong password on every account with an empty password field (`passwd -l <user>`).

findings.title: OpenSSH 8.9p1 affected by CVE-2024-6387
findings.description: regreSSHion: a signal handler race condition in sshd's SIGALRM handling (LoginGraceTime) can allow unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.
findings.evidence: 22/tcp banner 'OpenSSH 8.9p1 Ubuntu 3ubuntu0.6 Ubuntu Linux; protocol 2.0' matches affected range (>= 8.5p1 and < 9.8p1).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.8p1 or later. Distribution package detected: verify with the distro security tracker, the fix may be backported without a version change.

findings.title: OpenSSH 9.7p1 affected by CVE-2024-6387
findings.description: regreSSHion: a signal handler race condition in sshd's SIGALRM handling (LoginGraceTime) can allow unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.
findings.evidence: 22/tcp banner 'OpenSSH 9.7p1 protocol 2.0' matches affected range (>= 8.5p1 and < 9.8p1).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.8p1 or later.

findings.title: nginx 1.18.0 affected by CVE-2021-23017
findings.description: A one-byte memory overwrite in the nginx DNS resolver may allow an attacker able to forge UDP packets from the DNS server to crash the worker process or have other impact.
findings.evidence: 80/tcp banner 'nginx 1.18.0 Ubuntu' matches affected range (>= 0.6.18 and < 1.20.1).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade nginx to 1.20.1 or later. Distribution package detected: verify with the distro security tracker, the fix may be backported without a version change.

findings.title: nginx 1.18.0 affected by CVE-2021-23017
findings.description: A one-byte memory overwrite in the nginx DNS resolver may allow an attacker able to forge UDP packets from the DNS server to crash the worker process or have other impact.
findings.evidence: 443/tcp banner 'nginx 1.18.0 Ubuntu' matches affected range (>= 0.6.18 and < 1.20.1).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade nginx to 1.20.1 or later. Distribution package detected: verify with the distro security tracker, the fix may be backported without a version change.

findings.title: OpenSSL 1.0.1f affected by CVE-2014-0160
findings.description: Heartbleed: the TLS heartbeat extension in OpenSSL 1.0.1 through 1.0.1f does not properly handle heartbeat requests, disclosing process memory (private keys, credentials). A public exploit is available.
findings.evidence: 80/tcp banner 'Apache httpd 2.4.49 (Unix) OpenSSL/1.0.1f' matches affected range (>= 1.0.1 and <= 1.0.1f).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or later.

findings.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 affected by CVE-2021-41773
findings.description: Path traversal and file disclosure in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 via a flaw in path normalization; can lead to remote code execution when CGI is enabled. A public exploit is available.
findings.evidence: 80/tcp banner 'Apache httpd 2.4.49 (Unix) OpenSSL/1.0.1f' matches affected range (versions 2.4.49).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later.

findings.title: Redis exposed to the network
findings.description: Redis exposed to the network on 10.10.0.13:6379/tcp.
findings.recommendation: Bind Redis to 127.0.0.1, enable protected-mode and ACL authentication.

findings.title: Large outbound transfer from 10.10.0.13 to 203.0.113.50
findings.description: Large outbound transfer from 10.10.0.13 to 203.0.113.50
findings.recommendation: Verify the transfer is business-justified (backup, update). Otherwise treat as potential data exfiltration: block the destination and review the host.

findings.title: Access to known malicious domain malware-c2.example
findings.description: Access to known malicious domain malware-c2.example
findings.evidence: TLS connection (Sample malware command-and-control domain) from 10.10.0.13
findings.recommendation: Sinkhole/block the domain in DNS, investigate the client for compromise and reset exposed credentials.

findings.title: Telnet service exposed (cleartext credentials)
findings.description: Telnet service exposed (cleartext credentials) on 10.10.0.20:23/tcp.
findings.recommendation: Disable Telnet and use SSH with key-based authentication.

findings.title: Possible DNS tunnelling via tunnel-exfil.example
findings.description: Possible DNS tunnelling via tunnel-exfil.example
findings.evidence: 60 unique sub-domains queried under tunnel-exfil.example with very long query names
findings.recommendation: Block the domain, inspect the client, and restrict DNS egress to internal resolvers only.

findings.title: Possible port scan from 10.10.0.99
findings.description: Possible port scan from 10.10.0.99
findings.recommendation: Confirm whether the scan is authorised; if not, block the source and investigate the host.

findings.title: Critical system files have restrictive permissions
findings.description: Critical system files have restrictive permissions
findings.evidence: /etc/shadow mode 0o644 must not be accessible by others
findings.recommendation: Restore permissions: `chmod 644 /etc/passwd /etc/group; chmod 640 /etc/shadow /etc/gshadow; chmod 440 /etc/sudoers; chmod 600 /etc/ssh/sshd_config`.

findings.title: Host firewall is enabled
findings.description: Host firewall is enabled
findings.evidence: ufw is installed but disabled (ENABLED=no in /etc/ufw/ufw.conf)
findings.recommendation: Enable a default-deny host firewall (e.g. `ufw default deny incoming && ufw enable`, or nftables with an input chain policy of drop) and allow only required services.

findings.title: No high-risk services listening on all interfaces
findings.description: No high-risk services listening on all interfaces
findings.evidence: Exposed on all interfaces: tcp/3306 MySQL
findings.recommendation: Bind databases and admin services to localhost or a management interface, disable cleartext protocols (Telnet/FTP/rsh) and restrict access with the host firewall.

findings.title: SSH root login is disabled
findings.description: SSH root login is disabled
findings.recommendation: Set `PermitRootLogin no` in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and administer via named accounts + sudo.

findings.title: sudo always requires authentication (no NOPASSWD)
findings.description: sudo always requires authentication (no NOPASSWD)
findings.evidence: Passwordless sudo rules: /etc/sudoers.d/deploy: bob ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL
findings.recommendation: Remove NOPASSWD and !authenticate from sudoers rules (use `visudo`); grant passwordless sudo only to narrowly scoped automation commands.

findings.title: OpenSSH 8.9p1 affected by CVE-2023-48795
findings.description: Terrapin: the SSH transport protocol with certain OpenSSH extensions allows remote attackers to bypass integrity checks (prefix truncation), downgrading connection security. A public exploit is available.
findings.evidence: 22/tcp banner 'OpenSSH 8.9p1 Ubuntu 3ubuntu0.6 Ubuntu Linux; protocol 2.0' matches affected range (< 9.6p1).
findings.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.6p1 or later. Distribution package detected: verify with the distro security tracker, the fix may be backported without a version change.

findings.title: OpenSSH 7.4 affected by CVE-2023-48795
findings.description: Terrapin: the SSH transport protocol with certain OpenSSH extensions allows remote attackers to bypass integrity checks (prefix truncation), downgrading connection security. A public exploit is available.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.6p1 or later.

findings.title: OpenSSH 7.4 affected by CVE-2018-15473
findings.description: OpenSSH through 7.7 is prone to a user enumeration vulnerability due to not delaying bailout for an invalid authenticating user. A public exploit is available.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 7.8 or later.

findings.title: Database service reachable over the network
findings.description: Database service reachable over the network on 10.10.0.10:3306/tcp.
findings.recommendation: Restrict database ports to application servers via firewall rules and require TLS.

findings.title: FTP service exposed (cleartext credentials)
findings.description: FTP service exposed (cleartext credentials) on 10.10.0.11:21/tcp.
findings.recommendation: Replace FTP with SFTP/FTPS; if FTP is required, disable anonymous access.

findings.title: SMB/NetBIOS file sharing exposed
findings.description: SMB/NetBIOS file sharing exposed on 10.10.0.11:445/tcp.
findings.recommendation: Disable SMBv1, require SMB signing and restrict SMB to trusted segments.

findings.title: Legacy TLS/SSL protocol in use
findings.description: Legacy TLS/SSL protocol in use
findings.recommendation: Disable SSL 3.0/TLS 1.0/1.1 on clients and servers; require TLS 1.2+ (RFC 8996).

findings.title: Algorithmically generated (DGA-like) domain lookups
findings.description: Algorithmically generated (DGA-like) domain lookups
findings.recommendation: Inspect the querying hosts for malware; enable DNS filtering / RPZ.

findings.title: Connection attempt to suspicious port 4444
findings.description: Connection attempt to suspicious port 4444
findings.recommendation: Identify the process initiating the connection; block the port at the egress firewall if unused.

findings.title: Connection attempt to suspicious port 23
findings.description: Connection attempt to suspicious port 23
findings.recommendation: Identify the process initiating the connection; block the port at the egress firewall if unused.

findings.title: High rate of failed DNS resolutions (NXDOMAIN)
findings.description: High rate of failed DNS resolutions (NXDOMAIN)
findings.recommendation: Investigate clients generating failed lookups (DGA malware, misconfiguration).

findings.title: Unexpected traffic spike
findings.description: Unexpected traffic spike
findings.evidence: 20987369 bytes in 10s at 2026-10-25T19:36:20+00:00 = 1360.6x the median baseline (15425 bytes)
findings.recommendation: Correlate with top talkers at that time; check for DoS, misbehaving jobs or exfiltration.

findings.title: Password aging policy is enforced
findings.description: Password aging policy is enforced
findings.recommendation: In /etc/login.defs set PASS_MAX_DAYS 365 (or less), PASS_MIN_DAYS 1 and PASS_WARN_AGE 7.

findings.title: Password complexity is enforced (pam_pwquality)
findings.description: Password complexity is enforced (pam_pwquality)
findings.evidence: No pam_pwquality/pam_cracklib module in the PAM password stack
findings.recommendation: Install libpam-pwquality, reference pam_pwquality.so in the PAM password stack and set minlen = 14 in /etc/security/pwquality.conf.

findings.title: SSH password authentication is disabled
findings.description: SSH password authentication is disabled
findings.recommendation: Deploy SSH keys, then set `PasswordAuthentication no` and `KbdInteractiveAuthentication no`.

findings.title: SSH uses strong cryptographic algorithms only
findings.description: SSH uses strong cryptographic algorithms only
findings.recommendation: Remove CBC/arcfour/3DES ciphers, MD5/SHA1-96 MACs and SHA-1 key exchanges from Ciphers, MACs and KexAlgorithms (or rely on modern OpenSSH defaults).

findings.title: Web service without HTTPS
findings.description: HTTP on port 80 and no HTTPS listener detected on the host.
findings.recommendation: Enable HTTPS with a valid certificate and redirect HTTP to HTTPS (HSTS).

findings.title: Web service without HTTPS
findings.description: HTTP on port 8080 and no HTTPS listener detected on the host.
findings.recommendation: Enable HTTPS with a valid certificate and redirect HTTP to HTTPS (HSTS).

findings.title: Cleartext HTTP to Internet hosts
findings.description: Cleartext HTTP to Internet hosts
findings.recommendation: Enforce HTTPS (HSTS, browser policies, egress proxy) to protect data in transit.

findings.title: System auditing (auditd) is installed
findings.description: System auditing (auditd) is installed
findings.recommendation: Install and enable auditd (`apt install auditd && systemctl enable --now auditd`) with rules for identity, sudoers and authentication events.

findings.title: SSH MaxAuthTries is 4 or less
findings.description: SSH MaxAuthTries is 4 or less
findings.recommendation: Set `MaxAuthTries 4` to slow down online guessing.

findings.title: SSH X11 forwarding is disabled
findings.description: SSH X11 forwarding is disabled
findings.recommendation: Set `X11Forwarding no` unless strictly required.

findings.title: SSH idle session timeout is configured
findings.description: SSH idle session timeout is configured
findings.recommendation: Set `ClientAliveInterval 300` and `ClientAliveCountMax 3` (idle sessions closed after ~15 min).

findings.title: SSH LoginGraceTime is 60 seconds or less
findings.description: SSH LoginGraceTime is 60 seconds or less
findings.recommendation: Set `LoginGraceTime 60` to limit unauthenticated connection slots (also mitigates some DoS/race attacks).

findings.title: sudo uses a pseudo-terminal and logs to a file
findings.description: sudo uses a pseudo-terminal and logs to a file
findings.recommendation: Add `Defaults use_pty` and `Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo.log"` to /etc/sudoers.d/hardening.

findings.title: Automatic security updates are configured
findings.description: Automatic security updates are configured
findings.evidence: No automatic security update mechanism detected
findings.recommendation: Debian/Ubuntu: `apt install unattended-upgrades && dpkg-reconfigure -plow unattended-upgrades`. RHEL family: enable dnf-automatic with apply_updates = yes. On rolling distributions (Kali/Parrot) schedule regular `apt full-upgrade` instead.

findings.title: System accounts have no interactive shell
findings.description: System accounts have no interactive shell
findings.evidence: System accounts with a login shell: postgres. Interactive accounts: alice, bob, root, svc-backup
findings.recommendation: Set the shell of service/system accounts to /usr/sbin/nologin (`usermod -s /usr/sbin/nologin <user>`).

Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.56 or later.

Upgrade Apache Tomcat to 9.0.31 or later.
